comments.author: DonHopkins
comments.story: Gas Town's Agent Patterns, Design Bottlenecks, and Vibecoding at Scale
comments.text: I take it you never played The Sims? The simulation madness ship sailed 26 years ago, if not in 1986 with SimCity! ;) Palm is a fictional character in a text adventure — same tradition as Zork, LambdaMOO, and every MUD since 1978. The emojis are deliberate (navigation aids for LLMs, actually, and ethical simulated person flagging). The whimsy is intentional. I've been building simulated characters, world and city building tools since before The Sims shipped. This is just the next iteration. You may recognize tributes to many classic simulated characters in MOOLLM. MC Frontalot - It Is Pitch Dark: [VIDEO] The Grue monster carries his own game mechanics with him, eating you if you go for long enough in the maze without your lamp lit: grue: [LINK] The Wumpus has prototypes for his game playing pieces in his character directory: [LINK] wumpus-snorax: [LINK] BOTTOMLESS-PIT.yml: [LINK] SUPERBATS.yml: [LINK] And yes, it works great, and is fun and easy to author, for much less money than Steve's costly "Infinite Number of Typewriters Communicating Via Carrier Pigeon" approach.
